<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" font-family="sans-serif">
  <text x="200" y="28" text-anchor="middle" font-size="18" fill="#111" font-weight="bold">Nutrition: Predict, then Check</text>

  
  <rect x="30" y="55" width="150" height="90" fill="none" stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.5" rx="8" />
  <text x="105" y="78" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" fill="#111" font-weight="bold">PREDICT</text>
  <text x="105" y="100" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#111">Guess if food</text>
  <text x="105" y="116" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#111">has starch,</text>
  <text x="105" y="132" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#111">sugar or fat</text>

  
  <line x1="185" y1="100" x2="215" y2="100" stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <polygon points="215,100 207,95 207,105" fill="#111" />

  
  <rect x="220" y="55" width="150" height="90" fill="none" stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.5" rx="8" />
  <text x="295" y="78" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" fill="#111" font-weight="bold">CHECK</text>
  <text x="295" y="100" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#111">Test it!</text>
  <text x="295" y="116" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#111">Iodine → starch</text>
  <text x="295" y="132" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#111">Paper → fat</text>

  
  <text x="200" y="175" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="#111" font-weight="bold">Sample tests</text>

  
  <circle cx="70" cy="215" r="18" fill="none" stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="70" y="219" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="#111">Rice</text>
  <text x="70" y="255" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#111">Starch</text>
  <text x="70" y="270" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#111">iodine=blue</text>

  
  <circle cx="200" cy="215" r="18" fill="none" stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="200" y="219" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="#111">Fruit</text>
  <text x="200" y="255" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#111">Sugar</text>
  <text x="200" y="270" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#111">tastes sweet</text>

  
  <circle cx="330" cy="215" r="18" fill="none" stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="330" y="219" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="#111">Oil</text>
  <text x="330" y="255" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#111">Fat</text>
  <text x="330" y="270" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#111">greasy spot</text>
</svg>
